page_evidence.observation: The cover exposes school, team number, and member names.
The abstract reports data cleaning counts, motion-segment extraction, 33 features, PCA, K-means, and fuel-consumption verification.
Anomaly plots mark suspicious GPS and acceleration records before correction.
A PCA flowchart explains standardization, covariance, eigenvalues, contribution rate, and component selection.
A three-dimensional K-means scatter plot shows clustered driving segments.
Feature-weight bars support construction of the representative driving cycle.
Fuel-consumption relative error is reported before strengths and weaknesses.

abstract_structure.observation: Quantify data retained after cleaning, describe feature and clustering steps, then name the fuel-consumption validation target.

model_chain.observation: Detect GPS, time-gap, acceleration, and idle anomalies and interpolate selectively.
Extract driving segments and compute 33 motion features.
Use PCA to reduce correlated features.
Cluster segments with K-means and select representatives.
Weight characteristic segments to assemble the driving cycle.

validation_chain.observation: Visualize and list corrected anomalies before modeling.
Compare estimated fuel consumption with the original record and report relative error.

figures.lesson: Mark corrected records directly on the time series.
Turn a familiar algorithm into a reproducible ordered procedure.
Use color to identify segment classes while acknowledging projection limits.
Show which characteristics drive representative-cycle selection.

code_links.note: No independently packaged source tree was paired with this exact PDF; embedded appendix fragments are not treated as reproducible code.

transferable_rules.rule: Put data-retention counts in the abstract when cleaning materially changes the sample.
Show marked anomaly examples before presenting cleaned-data models.
Validate a constructed operating cycle through a downstream physical quantity such as fuel use.

risks.risk: A 3D PCA/K-means view can hide overlap and lacks quantitative cluster-quality metrics.
Validation relies heavily on one downstream error summary.
The award status is not independently verified beyond the mirror directory.

provenance.review_method: full-page render overview plus 4-7 high-resolution evidence-page visual checks and extracted-text review
